svg.title: Generating the two synthetic relation datasets
svg.desc: A: all 32 by 6 categorical attribute combinations define 192 subjects. The 32 objects have a cyclic f shift of three. Attribute-defined and independently balanced random relations share the same 128 training and 64 relation-held-out subjects and exact frequencies. B: 64 unique entities have ten balanced binary attributes. Ten equality tables are paired with a randomized 31-regular graph plus self loops, preserving 32 positive and 32 negative labels per row. Both families are serialized into token sequences. The two experiments reported in the manuscript are shown.
svg.text: Joint training after the equality warm-up
